title: Kestrel Dispensing Standard: Quantity of a Relabel Remake on Prescriptions
content:
The relabel remake quantity is the number of correctly labelled units dispensed at no charge on a Kestrel Prescriptions remake that answers a confirmed wrong-directions-label dispensing-error report.

## Standard

1. **The report answered.** The remake answers the most recently reported wrong-directions-label report on the prescription whose review outcome is confirmed.
2. **The mislabeled fill.** The fill that report names is the mislabeled fill.
3. **The quantity.** The relabel remake quantity is the quantity dispensed on the mislabeled fill, a whole number of units taken down to a whole number as a whole.

## Worked example (hypothetical records)

| Report | Reported | Review outcome | Fill named | Quantity dispensed on it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| wrong directions on the label | later | confirmed | fill C | 90 units |
| wrong directions on the label | earlier | confirmed | fill D | 30 units |
| wrong directions on the label | latest of all | pending review | fill E | 60 units |

The report still pending review cannot be answered. Of the confirmed ones, the most recently reported names fill C, so the relabel remake quantity is 90 units.
